Set up ADBuddy step by step: download Android platform-tools (checked against
Google's checksum), pair the phone over wireless debugging with a QR code (or
with --code), connect, read the phone's profile, pick the agent and create the
environment. Run it again at any time; it skips what is already done.

Over Tailscale or another network without mDNS, pair with --code and give the
connection address with --connect (or type it when asked).

Usage:
  adbuddy setup [flags]

Examples:
  adbuddy setup
  adbuddy setup --code
  adbuddy setup --code --connect 100.64.0.5:41234
  adbuddy setup --agent codex --yes

Flags:
      --adb string         use this adb (37 or newer) instead of downloading platform-tools
      --agent string       agent to use: claude, codex, gemini, opencode…
      --apk string         install this ADBuddy app APK instead of the latest release (a file you choose: if hybriqtech's release certificate did not sign it, exactly this APK becomes the trusted development build)
      --code               pair with IP:port and the 6-digit code instead of a QR code
      --connect string     connect by this IP:port when mDNS does not find the phone (Tailscale or another network), as its Wireless debugging screen shows it
  -h, --help               help for setup
      --no-app             do not install or set up the phone app
      --workspace string   agent environment (default: ~/ADBuddy/<phone model>)
      --yes                accept the recommended choices without asking

Global Flags:
      --json   machine-readable JSON output, for the commands that support it
